column3: The conjunction is omitted, and the phrase from the fish’s inward parts is moved to the beginning.
“To take my life” makes up to the soul a purpose clause.
“Beneath me barred me in” expands the earth’s bars behind me.
“Went up” adds upward movement to came.
“Idols” interprets the empty vanities; His replaces their in the reference to loving devotion.
